create_conv1d_layer: create a 1D convolution layer with specified input and output channels and kernel size
create_conv2d_layer: create a 2D convolution layer for image processing with configurable stride and padding
create_conv_transpose_layer: create a transposed convolution layer for upsampling feature maps
create_lazy_conv_layer: create a lazy convolution layer that infers in_channels from the first input tensor
test_depthwise_convolution: test depthwise convolution by setting groups equal to in_channels for channel-wise filtering
